exchanges: right so i have news, rohan finally got a job!! he's been applying for months and he got the call this morning, he's starting at a bank in the city on monday, we're all so happy for him
That's brilliant news after such a long search. He must be so relieved.
he is, he was literally dancing in the hallway. niamh made him a card, she's thoughtful like that
That's a lovely touch. Sounds like a supportive house.
we try, honestly it's a good bunch. mostly. the bins are another story but whatever
Every house has its bin saga. Is it a rota issue or just forgetfulness?

forgetfulness mostly. anyway i popped into the pharmacy earlier for some hayfever stuff and fatima who runs it was telling me about her archery club, she goes every sunday and she's apparently really good, she's got medals
That's a cool hobby, and medals too. Did she manage to sort your hayfever?
yeah she gave me some tablets, fingers crossed. my eyes have been streaming all week
Pollen season is brutal. Hopefully they kick in quickly.
hope so. oh and the landlord mr oyelaran is apparently sending someone about the damp in the bathroom finally, only took three emails
Persistence pays off. Damp is worth staying on top of before it spreads.
that's what i said. niamh's room is the worst because it's next to the bathroom, she's got mould on the ceiling
That's not great to sleep next to. Hopefully the fix covers her room too.

yeah i'll make sure. ugh. ok on a nicer note we went to giorgos's café for breakfast, the one with the blue shutters, he does these amazing spinach pies, he's from Crete and says his mum's recipe is the only proper one
Family recipes are hard to argue with. That sounds like a great breakfast spot.
it's the best. his wife works there too, she's from Athens and they bicker about whose home does food better, it's very entertaining
A friendly rivalry over breakfast sounds like great service.
it really is. we're going back on saturday probably
Good plan, places like that are worth being regulars at.

so the other fatima, the one upstairs from us, has turned her whole balcony into a vegetable patch, there's tomatoes and beans hanging over the railings and she's out there gardening every evening when i get home
That sounds like a little urban farm. You might get some produce passed down if you're friendly.
she already gave us courgettes, loads of them, we don't know what to do with them
Courgette fritters or a big soup could use them up fast.
ooh fritters, i'll suggest that
They're quick and good for a crowd.
chloe will eat anything so she'll be happy
Always good to have one easy eater in the house.

true she's a bottomless pit. oh i completely got rohan's thing wrong this morning by the way, it's not a bank he's starting at, it's an insurance company, i just heard 'finance' and assumed. he laughed at me
Easy assumption to make. Either way it's a new job and a steady start.
yeah exactly, he doesn't care, he's just happy to be working
That's the main thing after months of applying.
we're doing a little celebration tomorrow, nothing big, just pizza
Simple and fun, pizza's always a crowd-pleaser.
and fritters apparently lol
Ha, an unusual combo, but it'll use up the courgettes.
haha yes. ok the damp guy just texted, he's coming at 8 tomorrow which is way too early
Early, but at least it's happening. Maybe someone who's up anyway can let him in.
chloe's up at 6 anyway so she can
Perfect, problem solved.
my eyes are finally calming down too
Good, sounds like the tablets are doing their job.
thank god. i was looking like i'd been crying all day at work
Ha, that must have raised a few concerned looks.
oh and niamh just turned up with an electric scooter, she's decided she's done with buses forever, she nearly crashed into the gate coming in
Bold move! Hopefully she gets the hang of the brakes soon.
she's practising up and down the street now, the neighbours are watching lol
Free entertainment for the street then.
basically yeah. ok i'm going to go watch her fall off probably
Ha, be supportive, maybe have a plaster ready.

where was giorgos from again, the café guy
rohan's new job is with an insurance company isn't it
what did niamh come home riding
does rohan have any hobbies, like what's he into
honestly i love this time of year when it stays light till late
